build_VectorEnv: build a VectorEnv with multiple parallel habitat environments using a custom make_env_fn and env_fn_args
run_VectorEnv_step: run a synchronized step across all vectorized environments by passing a list of actions to step
run_VectorEnv_reset: reset all vectorized environments and collect observation outputs from each worker process
create_ThreadedVectorEnv: create a ThreadedVectorEnv that runs multiple environments in threads within a single process for debugging
call_VectorEnv_call: call an arbitrary function or retrieve a property on a specific environment by index and function name
